description:
You are one of several procurement officers at a hospital network choosing a vendor for a new patient-records system. Each officer has reviewed different parts of the bids and reference checks.

The options are:
- Vendor A (Talume Vatir)
- Vendor B (Quolyntal Quorinbel)
- Vendor C (Ripollu Yertirne)
- Vendor D (Beltho Fenvokri)

Exactly one option is best overall. Which vendor should be selected? Your notes are incomplete: other participants hold information you do not have.

agents.shard_text:
Vendor A (Talume Vatir):
  - Vendor A completed a successful pilot at a peer hospital
  - Vendor A has a stable engineering team
  - Vendor A refuses to include an uptime guarantee
  - Vendor A quoted a total cost of 316 thousand per year
Vendor B (Quolyntal Quorinbel):
  - Vendor B guarantees 99.9% uptime in its contract
  - Vendor B provides no staff training
  - Vendor B keeps backups only on-site
  - Vendor B offers straightforward contract exit terms
  - Vendor B has reported financial difficulties
